subject: HSPACE kickoff - synthetic humans at scale for 3D sensing
body:
Team,

Kicking off HSPACE. The thesis: 3D human sensing is bottlenecked on datasets with real 3D ground truth - multiple people, motion, occlusion, moving cameras - and we can manufacture that data synthetically. Our pipeline fits the GHUM body model to single scans, then re-targets and places animated, dressed humans into complex indoor and outdoor scenes. With a hundred base individuals plus parametric shape variation we get 1,600 distinct humans and an initial dataset north of one million frames, all compatible with real-time rendering and game engines.

Product framing: this becomes the training-data backbone for every 3D human pose/shape effort in the vision portfolio, plus an external evaluation server down the line.

Milestones: retargeting pipeline hardened by end of March, scene-placement QA pass through April, full render campaign in May, dataset v1 frozen by 2026-06-08.

Alina owns staffing/compute; Freya methodology; Farah and Milan the pipeline.

Lucia
